title: Bu Yaştan Sonra
author: Toprak Işık
description:
Fifty-five-year-old Güner, a recently retired colonel adjusting to civilian life as a corporate security manager, begins an affair with Ceyda, the company’s young and uninhibited new saleswoman, after his confidence in his masculinity is shaken. With his womanising friend Halit acting as adviser and accomplice, supposedly innocent bridge nights become cover for increasingly complicated encounters involving wives, children and colleagues. Yet Ceyda refuses to remain a convenient fantasy, forcing Güner to confront uncomfortable questions about marriage, fidelity and the double standards that excuse men while condemning women.

Driven by sparkling dialogue, comic reversals and sharply observed characters, At This Age is a fast-paced social satire that explores ageing, desire, patriarchal privilege and the loneliness, regrets and fears concealed beneath the pursuit of intimacy.
